facts.label: Crachá perdido
facts.sub: Diga I lost my badge. Responda I think yesterday evening. Compare Is a temporary badge slower than a new one? Pergunte How much is a new badge? e decida I’ll order a new one today.

facts.label: O crachá
facts.sub: Muitos escritórios americanos usam crachás para abrir portas e elevadores. Perder o crachá exige avisar a segurança o mais rápido possível.

facts.label: Crachá temporário
facts.sub: A segurança dá um crachá temporário, que é mais rápido que um novo. Ele abre menos portas e vale por poucos dias, até o definitivo chegar.

pages.title: A temporary badge · 1/3
paragraphs: It is eight in the morning in a big office building in Houston. Rui stands at the entrance and searches his pockets. His badge is not there. He checks his bag, his jacket and his wallet. At the security desk, an officer named Gail watches him. He walks over with an embarrassed smile.
“Good morning. I lost my badge.” says Rui. “Oh no. When did you lose it?” says Gail. “I think yesterday evening. I looked everywhere.” says Rui.
